senses.title: 出现；显现；问世
senses.meaning: 进入视线、显现出来；也可指新事物开始存在或出版、上映。
senses.usageNote: 常与 in、on、from 等表示出现地点或来源的介词搭配。

examples.en: A rainbow appeared over the lake after the rain.
examples.zh: 雨后，湖面上方出现了一道彩虹。

examples.en: Her first story appeared in the school magazine.
examples.zh: 她的第一个故事刊登在校刊上。
examples.note: appear in 表示作品刊登或出现于某出版物中。

patterns.zh: 出现在……里／上；刊登或播出在……上
patterns.note: 地点、页面、杂志、电视节目等都可作其后补充信息。

patterns.zh: 突然出现；不知从哪里冒出来
patterns.note: 常用于描述某人或某物出乎意料地出现。

collocations.zh: 出现在书中；刊登在书里
collocations.note: 可用于文字、图片或人物。
可指人物露面，也可指节目播出。

similar.note: 语气较口语，常强调某人终于来了或现身。
常指从遮挡处、黑暗中或不明显的状态中显露出来。

contrasting.note: 与“进入视线、显现”这一义相对；不表示所有 appear 用法的反义。

relatedExpressions.similarNote: show up 更口语，常用于人到场；emerge 强调从遮挡或不明显处显现。
relatedExpressions.contrastingNote: disappear 只适合与“显现、出现”这一义对照；appear 表示“看起来”时不能直接用它作反义词。

senses.title: 看起来；似乎
senses.meaning: 根据看到或了解到的情况，显得好像是某种状态或正在做某事。
senses.usageNote: 常用 appear to be + 名词或形容词，也可用 appear to do；在日常表达中，seem 常比 appear 更常见。

examples.en: The sky appears to be clear, but take an umbrella just in case.
examples.zh: 天看起来很晴朗，不过还是带把伞以防万一。
examples.note: appear to be + 形容词，表示“看起来……”。

examples.en: Mia appears to know the answer.
examples.note: appear to do 表示“似乎做……”。

patterns.en: appear to be + 名词／形容词
patterns.note: 用于表达观察者的判断，不一定表示已经证实。

collocations.note: appear 后可直接接形容词。

similar.note: 最常见的近义表达，语气通常较日常；可说 seem to be 或 seem to do。
look 常强调外表或视觉印象，如 look tired；appear 也可表达根据情况作出的判断。

contrasting.note: 在“看起来似乎”这一语境中作对照：appear 表示印象或判断，prove to be 表示后来证实的结果。

relatedExpressions.similarNote: seem 适用范围广、语气较日常；look 更偏向视觉印象。
relatedExpressions.contrastingNote: prove to be 可用于与“似乎如此”对照，强调事实后来得到证明；它不是 appear 的通用反义词。

senses.title: 到场；出席；露面
senses.meaning: 来到某个地方或活动中，特别是出现在众人面前。
senses.usageNote: 表示到场时，常用 appear at + 地点或活动；show up 在日常口语中更常用。

examples.en: The singer appeared at the school concert on Friday.
examples.zh: 这位歌手周五在学校音乐会上露面了。
examples.note: appear at 表示在活动中露面。

examples.en: Everyone was ready, but Leo didn’t appear until noon.
examples.zh: 大家都准备好了，可利奥直到中午才到。
examples.note: 此处 appear 指来到、出现。

patterns.note: 常用于活动、会议或公开场合。
可用于法庭等正式场合。

collocations.note: 强调到场，不一定表示发言。

similar.note: 日常口语中常用，常带有“终于来了”的意味。
强调参加活动，常用于会议、课程或活动；不一定强调公开露面。

contrasting.note: 在活动出席语境中，可与 appear at / attend 对照。

relatedExpressions.similarNote: show up 更口语；attend 强调参加活动，适合会议、课程等语境。
relatedExpressions.contrastingNote: miss 只在是否参加某活动的语境中与此义对照。

confusions.title: appear to do 与 appear doing
confusions.summary: 表达“似乎做某事”时，常用 appear to do；不要把 to 漏掉后直接接动词 -ing。

items.label: appear to do
items.note: 正确结构：appear 后接 to 和动词原形。

example.en: The dog appears to sleep beside the door.
example.note: appear to sleep 表示“似乎在睡觉”。

items.label: appear doing
items.note: 通常不能用来表达“似乎正在做某事”；改用 appear to be doing。

example.en: The dog appears to be sleeping beside the door.
example.zh: 那只狗看起来正在门边睡觉。
example.note: 进行中的动作可用 appear to be + -ing。

confusions.takeaway: 表达“似乎做某事”用 appear to do；强调“似乎正在做”用 appear to be doing。

confusions.title: appear 与 appearance
confusions.summary: appear 是动词，表示出现或看起来；appearance 是名词，可表示外貌、出现或露面。

items.label: appear（动词）
items.note: 描述发生的动作或给人的印象。

example.note: appeared 是 appear 的过去式。

items.label: appearance（名词）
items.note: 描述外貌，或指一次露面、出现。

example.en: The actor made a brief appearance at the festival.
example.zh: 这位演员在节庆活动中短暂露面。
example.note: make an appearance 表示露面。

confusions.takeaway: 句中需要表示“出现、显得”的动词时用 appear；说“外貌”或“一次露面”时用 appearance。

etymology.summary: appear 经古法语形式进入英语，来源可追溯到拉丁语 apparere；它早期与显现、进入视线有关，后来也发展出“看起来、似乎”的用法。

stages.meaning: appear 经由这些古法语形式传入英语。

etymology.caveat: 这是历史词源说明；appear 的 a + ppear 不是现代英语中可拆解的构词方式。记忆联想也不代表词源。

example.en: Her appearance at the game surprised us.
example.zh: 她出现在比赛现场，让我们很意外。
example.note: appearance 在此表示露面、出现。

wordFamily.formation: dis- + appear，表示从视线中消失。
wordFamily.spellingNote: appear 前加 dis-；出现时拼作 disappear，只有一个 s。

example.en: The path disappeared into the fog.
example.note: 与 appear 的显现义形成常用词汇对照。

output.wordFamilyNote: appearance 和 disappear 是常见同族词；appear 的规则变形为 appears、appeared、appearing。

senses.title: 似乎；显得
senses.meaning: 根据外表或已有迹象判断某人或某事像是某种状态；语气通常比断言更保留。
senses.usageNote: 常用 appear to be + 名词/形容词，或 appear to do；也可用 It appears that...。

senses.title: 到场；露面

confusions.title: appear 与 seem：语气和依据
confusions.summary: 两者都可表示“似乎”，但 seem 更日常；appear 稍正式，常用于根据迹象作判断。

items.label: appear

confusions.title: appear 与 look：依据不同

sourceEvidence.text: Appear came through Old French aparoir or aperer from Latin apparere. These forms concerned becoming visible or coming into view. The Latin formation includes ad and parere, whose relevant meaning involves coming forth or being visible. English later developed the seeming or apparent-state use. The deeper origin of parere is uncertain and need not be extended into a definite prehistoric chain.

findings.issue: The author said appear ended in silent e and required dropping e.
findings.resolution: Explained that appear ends in r and directly takes -ing, preserving both p letters; regional IPA checked against Oxford.

findings.issue: Visible appearance and publication were grouped under one definition with only one example each; common performance coverage was demoted to one optional example.
findings.resolution: Built seven source-grounded core units, with at least two original examples each; publication and performance are separate from visibility.

findings.issue: Useful direct-adjective/that structures and the sense-specific progressive restriction were missing.
findings.resolution: Added original calm/that examples and distinguished nonprogressive impression use from progressive performing.

findings.issue: Unrestricted appear for + appointment could obscure specialized legal representation.
findings.resolution: Use clear arrival patterns; keep two source-grounded legal readings optional and separately exemplified.

findings.issue: Comparisons needed to track the newly separated senses.
findings.resolution: Explain disappear for visibility/existence, prove to be for evidential contrast, unpublished for publication, and act/star distinctions for performance; no universal antonym claim.

findings.issue: The French stage only described its position in the route instead of meaning, and the route stopped before English.
findings.resolution: Give actual meanings and complete Latin-to-French-to-English direction; stop at the uncertain deeper source.

findings.issue: Appearance was represented as though English direct suffixation were its complete history; one translation added an unspecified duration.
findings.resolution: Distinguish modern spelling mnemonic from French borrowing, remove added duration, and add useful reappear with a dedicated source and original example.

findings.issue: The lesson did not explicitly prevent passive appeared for the ordinary intransitive visibility use.
findings.resolution: Added appear versus see subject/object contrast and clearly labelled the invalid passive example.
